## Why visit

A particularly useful choice for the feel of a working city-centre local alongside a strong cask offer. Wood panelling, columns and a succession of drinking areas give the long bar more character than the exterior might suggest. The old brewery glass and surviving tiled details reward a look, but this is principally somewhere to settle with a well-chosen beer. It makes a good bridge between the Lion’s preserved interior and Ship & Mitre’s bigger range, with a distinct local atmosphere of its own.

## Beer

CAMRA records regular and changing cask, with regional brewers from north-west England and Wales represented.
